results.title: Trump downplays the need to check AI development and says he doesn’t want to cede edge to China
results.description: DUBLIN (AP) — President Donald Trump on Sunday played down the need for his administration to check the development of artificial intelligence, saying he worried about ceding America’s edge over China in a global competition and that winning would help would address the risks from the advancing technology.
